reflection: No results are visible in this run, so I can't tell which round 1 factors worked. I'll build on the round 1 ideas with small changes: smoother versions, volatility-normalised versions, and a few new angles. The aim is to avoid near-duplicates of the 22 existing factors (similarity below 0.90) while adding information they lack. The new angles are volume, intraday direction, and cross-asset dispersion.

lessons.name: aapl_vol10_to_vol60_ratio
lessons.lesson: Volatility regime ratio is probably correlated with existing vol factors, but the 60d baseline adds some new information; I'm smoothing it with a log.

lessons.name: msft_return_zscore_20d
lessons.lesson: MSFT_return_1d is already useful, and the z-score rescales it by recent vol, which may help across regimes; I'll try an AAPL-relative version.

lessons.name: aapl_overnight_gap
lessons.lesson: The gap captures overnight sentiment and may mean-revert; it is noisy alone, so I'll combine it with the intraday move.

lessons.name: aapl_close_location_in_range
lessons.lesson: Close location is a bounded reversal/continuation signal, but its single-day value is noisy; I'll smooth it.

lessons.name: qqq_vol_ratio_5_20
lessons.lesson: Market vol-regime shift may matter only in stress years like 2022 and 2025, so it may need an interaction with Apple's own state.

lessons.name: aapl_minus_msft_5d_relative
lessons.lesson: Relative 5d performance may mean-revert, but it overlaps the existing 5d factors; I'll normalise it by vol.

factors.name: aapl_close_location_avg_3d
factors.hypothesis: Single-day close location is noisy; a 3-day average gives a steadier buying/selling pressure signal.

factors.name: aapl_minus_msft_5d_vol_scaled
factors.hypothesis: Scaling the relative move by Apple's vol makes it comparable across calm and turbulent years, so any mean reversion in it should stay stable.

factors.name: aapl_intraday_return
factors.hypothesis: Intraday direction separates the day's own move from the overnight gap and may carry different next-day information.

factors.name: peer_dispersion_1d
factors.hypothesis: When the peers disagree, the tech sector is in a mixed state, and Apple's next move may be less predictable or revert.

factors.name: aapl_volume_trend_signed
factors.hypothesis: Combining the day's direction with relative volume shows conviction behind the move, which complements close location, a price-only pressure signal.

factors.name: qqq_trend_vs_aapl_gap_20d
factors.hypothesis: Apple's 20-day lag or lead against the market, paired with the market volatility regime, may identify when catch-up or reversion happens.
